elements.title: Vertical Boxplot for Ages of Major League Baseball Players

values.distribution: right-skewed (longer upper whisker than lower whisker)

details.trend: distribution is not symmetric, median line not centered in box

elements.summary: This vertical boxplot visualizes the distribution of ages of Major League Baseball players, showing a right-skewed distribution with the median age around 29 and ages ranging from about 26 to 41.
